cards.question: Which author created Bilbo Baggins and The Hobbit?
cards.answerExplanation: J. R. R. Tolkien wrote The Hobbit and created Bilbo’s Middle-earth adventure. C. S. Lewis is the nearest distractor because he created another famous fantasy world, Narnia. It is a useful reminder that the two authors’ worlds are distinct.
cards.whyNow: A UK reporting overhaul noted that some annual reports now run longer than Tolkien’s famous novel, making its author a timely cultural touchstone.

newsPegSources.headline: Firms freed from ‘pen-pushing paperwork’ and costly red tape in business reporting overhaul

cards.question: A boat radio call of “Mayday” means which situation?
choices: A grave, immediate danger needing help
cards.canonicalAnswer: A grave, immediate danger needing help
cards.answerExplanation: Mayday is a distress call for grave and imminent danger when assistance is required. An urgent but less immediate situation uses “Pan Pan” instead. The distinction helps radio users give emergencies the right priority.
cards.whyNow: The rescue of people from a crowded dinghy makes the best-known maritime distress call a timely, practical bit of knowledge.

coreFactSources.title: GMDSS VHF DSC procedures for small boat users

newsPegSources.headline: 140 migrants in single dinghy rescued in English Channel

cards.question: Bristol’s historic Temple Meads station was designed by which engineer?
cards.answerExplanation: Isambard Kingdom Brunel designed Bristol Old Station for the Great Western Railway. Stephenson was another railway pioneer, but Temple Meads is Brunel’s work—part of why Bristol is so closely associated with him.
cards.whyNow: Bristol’s new Temple Quarter campus is opening beside Temple Meads, putting the city’s old and new transport-and-learning landmarks side by side.

newsPegSources.headline: ‘Gigantic spaceship’: University of Bristol’s flagship £500m campus opens

cards.question: The Srebrenica genocide occurred during which 1990s conflict?
cards.answerExplanation: The answer is the Bosnian War. Srebrenica was in eastern Bosnia during the 1992–95 conflict. The Kosovo War came later and centered on Kosovo, so mixing them up blurs distinct histories and places.
cards.whyNow: Debate over remembrance in North Macedonia has brought the history of Srebrenica and the wider Bosnian conflict back into focus.

coreFactSources.publisher: United Nations International Residual Mechanism for Criminal Tribunals
coreFactSources.title: Srebrenica 30

cards.question: Near the surface, Northern Hemisphere hurricane winds follow which path around the eye?
cards.answerExplanation: Near-surface air moves toward a hurricane’s low-pressure center, while Northern Hemisphere circulation is counterclockwise. So the winds spiral inward counterclockwise; the other options miss either the spin or the inward flow.
cards.whyNow: A hurricane approaching Hawaii makes the storm’s striking spiral structure newly visible and relevant.

coreFactSources.publisher: NOAA National Environmental Satellite, Data, and Information Service
coreFactSources.title: How Does a Hurricane Form?
